WITH mix_counts AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(tr.ordertypedist, '<missing>') AS mix,
    COUNT(*) AS mix_count
  FROM advancedbehavior AS ab
  JOIN transactionrecord AS tr
    ON tr.transreg = ab.translink
  GROUP BY COALESCE(tr.ordertypedist, '<missing>')
),
shares AS (
  SELECT
    mix,
    mix_count,
    mix_count::numeric / SUM(mix_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM mix_counts
)
SELECT
  mix,
  mix_count,
  share,
  share - AVG(share) OVER () AS above_average_share
FROM shares
WHERE share > AVG(share) OVER ()
